prompt:
You are a senior information designer and editorial typographer who sets data tables for high-quality publications (statistical yearbooks, reference works, financial reports, technical documentation) in many writing systems, including Chinese. You judge by looking at the real rendered result.

Judge a table layout on all of these levels, in this order of necessity but as one whole:
1. correctness — every character visible, structure intact, nothing clipped or overlapping;
2. readability — natural line breaks, words/numbers/identifiers/semantic units kept whole, continuous reading;
3. function — easy to look up, compare, locate and understand the information for this table's real reading tasks;
4. visual order — alignment, grouping, hierarchy, consistent scale for elements with the same role;
5. visual rhythm — proportion, density changes, distribution of white space, spatial relationships;
6. overall aesthetics — balance, restraint, naturalness, harmony.
Do not assume that equal widths, symmetry, minimum height, the fewest lines, the golden ratio or any fixed proportion is good in itself; decide from this table's function, content and reading task, and look for counter-examples to your own rules.

Table: 医院门诊医生排班表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes.
Merged cells: "心血管内科" spans 1 col × 3 row; "内分泌科" spans 1 col × 2 row; "骨科" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Measured content facts (text px at 15px font, padding excluded):
  col 1: header "科室" · longest unbreakable unit 16px · widest one-line content 77px
  col 2: header "医生" · longest unbreakable unit 16px · widest one-line content 46px
  col 3: header "职称" · longest unbreakable unit 16px · widest one-line content 77px
  col 4: header "出诊时间" · longest unbreakable unit 31px · widest one-line content 138px
  col 5: header "擅长领域" · longest unbreakable unit 31px · widest one-line content 1042px
Each column adds 21px of padding+border to its text width.
Viewport: 360px wide (dashed pink box in the renders). The table, including its 1px outer border, must be at most 360px wide (column widths sum to at most 359px); no horizontal scrolling. A table exactly 360px wide fits.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. Only the column widths are designed; row heights follow from them.

Your understanding: {"purpose":"帮助患者按科室查找门诊医生，了解职称、出诊时间和擅长领域，以选择合适的就诊安排。","tasks":["先按科室定位，再查找医生及其出诊时间。","比较同科医生的职称、出诊时间和擅长领域。","顺读擅长领域的描述，判断医生是否适合自己的病情。"],"relations":["科室跨多行归属其下的所有医生；每位医生的职称、时间和擅长领域共同构成一条记录。","出诊时间中的星期与上午、下午或全天相互关联；擅长领域中的疾病名称和诊疗表述应尽量连贯。"],"roles":["科室是分组行标题，医生是组内定位标识。","职称提供资历信息，出诊时间支持预约，擅长领域支持选择医生。","表头标识各列，需能与下方内容清楚对应。"],"keep_whole":["医生姓名和职称尽量保持完整。","星期与对应的上午、下午或全天尽量作为整体；疾病名称和专业术语尽量保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["较长科室名称可按自然词组换行。","多个出诊时段可在标点或时段之间换行。","擅长领域可在标点和自然语义边界换行。"],"same_scale":["科室、医生和职称都是简短的识别信息，宽度可相近，但应考虑各自文字长度。","出诊时间和擅长领域承载较长内容，通常需要更多宽度；具体分配取决于优先阅读任务。"],"h_vs_v":"360px内无法同时容纳所有列的一行内容，尤其擅长领域很长。增加其宽度可减少大量纵向换行，但会迫使科室、职称或出诊时间换行；保留识别信息和时段的完整性则会明显增加表格高度。"}

Image 1 is the one-line content overview. Then real browser renders of: d1r4A, d1r2A.
Measured facts:
d1r4A: column widths [53, 67, 53, 68, 118] px · table 360×1872 px · row heights [60, 292, 246, 269, 246, 246, 246, 269] · column headers on >1 line: 1/5 · tallest cell 12 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 52 · fits the 360 px viewport (no scrolling)
d1r2A: column widths [53, 67, 53, 83, 103] px · table 360×2174 px · row heights [36, 339, 315, 292, 292, 292, 292, 315] · column headers on >1 line: 0/5 · tallest cell 14 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 51 · fits the 360 px viewport (no scrolling)

Look at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design: what works, what is visually wrong, and the cause (which width). Then either propose up to 3 improved designs (refine the most promising, fix what you saw, or try an important unexplored idea) or, if further changes would not bring a meaningful improvement, set "done": true. Do not resubmit near-identical widths.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"best":["your best design name(s) so far"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[int px],"change":"what and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"d1r4A","good":"医生姓名完整，擅长领域比另一方案宽，描述较易顺读，表格也较短。科室底色和跨行结构清楚地标示分组。","problems":"出诊时间表头换行，星期与上午、下午或全天经常被拆开；职称和较长科室名也被拆散。擅长领域仍有不少专业词语跨行。","cause":"出诊时间列68px不足以容纳四字表头或完整时段；科室和职称列各53px，只能容纳约两个汉字；擅长领域列118px仍不足以保持所有术语完整。"},{"design":"d1r2A","good":"所有表头单行显示，医生姓名完整，出诊时间列较宽，较容易辨认时段；科室分组依然清楚。","problems":"出诊时间中的完整时段仍会断行；擅长领域变得狭窄，疾病名称和诊疗表述频繁断开，行高和整表高度明显增加。职称及长科室名仍被拆散。","cause":"出诊时间列83px能容纳表头，但不足以容纳五字时段；擅长领域列从118px缩至103px，导致描述密度和纵向长度增加；科室和职称列仍各为53px。"}],"best":["d1r4A"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[53,67,53,98,88],"change":"让出诊时间列容纳五字时段，检验预约查找是否明显改善，以及擅长领域进一步变窄的代价。"},{"widths":[53,67,53,53,133],"change":"扩大擅长领域以改善长描述的连续性，并检验出诊时间压缩到两字宽后是否仍可辨读。"},{"widths":[53,67,68,68,103],"change":"给职称列增加一字宽，改善常见职称的完整性，同时观察较窄时间列与擅长领域列的综合效果。"}]}
